VI.description: The hover part of one server loop iteration (docs\5Carchitecture.md\2C Popups)\3A makes the remote pointer act on open LabVIEW menus as a local pointer does\2C without moving the host cursor or any window. The pointer position comes from RemoteVI Menu Pointer.vi (RemoteVI Note Popup Pointer.vi stores each WM_MOUSEMOVE a client sends while a popup is open\2C so a burst of moves is coalesced to the latest one). While a popup is open and a position waits\2C RemoteVI Hover Menus.vi does one step with keys\3A over the DEEPEST menu the highlight is moved onto the item under the pointer (VK_DOWN / VK_UP)\2C and when it has stayed on one item for 400 ms VK_RIGHT is posted once - it opens that item's submenu next to its parent as a local hover does\2C and does nothing on an item without one (measured)\3B over a PARENT of open submenus nothing happens on the item that opened the submenu\2C elsewhere after 300 ms of rest the submenus are closed with VK_LEFT and the parent's highlight follows. A popup that takes no keys (colour picker\2C line width popup) gets no hover. In an iteration in which a client clicked (clicked?) no step is made - the click has just set the state. When no popup is open the state is reset\2C except swallow up (the button-up of a click that chose a menu item). Win32 only\2C no VI Server call\3B errors are dropped.
